title: Terms of Subscription — Suspension for Arrears and Restart of a Lapsed Subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Suspension for Arrears and Restart of a Lapsed Subscription

## Clause

Reporting and dashboard access under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions are withdrawn once an invoice stays unpaid beyond the tier's suspension period counted from the day the invoice fell due, counting calendar days with the due day excluded and the final day included. Data collection continues while a subscription is suspended, so the record is unbroken when reporting resumes, but no report is issued and no study is delivered meanwhile, and a guarantee true-up falling in a suspension is deferred rather than lost. Reporting is restored when the arrears are settled and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged. A subscription that lapsed at its term end may be restarted on the same baseline only inside the tier's restart window counted forward in calendar days from the term end date, the end day excluded and the final day included; past that window a new baseline is established from fresh data before the guarantee can stand again. The suspension period, the reinstatement fee and the restart window are the figures fixed for the tier.

## Suspension — counting rule

The clock starts on the invoice's due day as the invoice record holds it; the due day is excluded and calendar days are counted forward. The invoice is beyond the suspension period from the day after the last day of the period, that last day being included in the period. An invoice unpaid on the final day of the period is not yet beyond it; unpaid on the following day, it is.

| Hypothetical | Suspension period | Still unpaid on | Beyond the period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Due 1 May | 30 days | 31 May | no — day thirty, included in the period |
| Due 1 May | 30 days | 1 June | yes |

## During a suspension

- Data collection continues; the record is unbroken when reporting resumes.
- No report is issued and no study is delivered.
- A guarantee true-up falling in the suspension is deferred, not lost.

## Reinstatement

Reporting is restored when the arrears are settled, and the tier's reinstatement fee is charged.

## Restart of a lapsed subscription — counting rule

The clock starts on the term end date as the subscription record holds it; the end day is excluded, calendar days are counted forward and the final day of the window is included. A restart on the final day keeps the same baseline; a restart the day after does not, and a new baseline is established from fresh data before the guarantee can stand again.

| Hypothetical | Restart window | Restarted | Same baseline |
|---|---|---|---|
| Term ended 30 September | 60 days | 29 November | yes — the sixtieth day |
| Term ended 30 September | 60 days | 30 November | no — new baseline from fresh data |
